IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects O JOIN sys.schemas S ON O.schema_id = S.schema_id WHERE O.NAME = 'testtable1' AND O.TYPE = 'U' AND S.NAME = 'dbo')
CREATE TABLE dbo.testtable1
	(
	 [Segment] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Country] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Product] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Discount_Band] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Units_sold] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Manufacturing_price] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Sale_price] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Gross_sales] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Discounts] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Sales] nvarchar(4000),
	 [COGS] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Profit] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Date] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Month_number] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Month_name] nvarchar(4000),
	 [Year] nvarchar(4000)
	)
WITH
	(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	 CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
	 -- HEAP
	)
GO

--Uncomment the 4 lines below to create a stored procedure for data pipeline orchestration​
--CREATE PROC bulk_load_testtable1
--AS
--BEGIN
COPY INTO dbo.testtable1
(Segment 1, Country 2, Product 3, Discount_Band 4, Units_sold 5, Manufacturing_price 6, Sale_price 7, Gross_sales 8, Discounts 9, Sales 10, COGS 11, Profit 12, Date 13, Month_number 14, Month_name 15, Year 16)
FROM 'https://cbcd360devstoacct01sg.dfs.core.windows.net/testoutput/test_sample_20220513.csv'
WITH
(
	FILE_TYPE = 'CSV'
	,MAXERRORS = 0
	,ERRORFILE = 'https://cbcd360devstoacct01sg.dfs.core.windows.net/testoutput/'
	,CREDENTIAL = ( IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity' )
	,ERRORFILE_CREDENTIAL = ( IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity' )
)
--END
GO

SELECT TOP 100 * FROM dbo.testtable1
GO
